france.name: France (Schengen)
france.description: The most requested Schengen destination from Morocco. Ideal for tourism, business, and study (Campus France).

tourist.name: Tourist Visa (Type C)
tourist.description: For short stays up to 90 days for tourism or visiting family/friends.
requirements: Valid Passport (issued within last 10 years, valid for 3+ months beyond return date, 2+ blank pages)
Two recent biometric passport photos (ICAO standard, white background)
Schengen Visa application form, fully completed and signed via France-Visas
Travel Medical Insurance (minimum coverage €30,000, valid for entire Schengen area)
Proof of Accommodation (hotel reservation or host invitation 'Attestation d'accueil')
Proof of Financial Means (bank statements for last 3 months showing min. 3000 MAD/day)
Proof of Socio-Economic Status (work certificate, last 3 salary slips, CNSS registration, or commerce registry)
Family record book (Livret de famille) for married applicants

student.name: Student Visa (Type D)
student.description: For long stays over 90 days to study at a French university or language school.
requirements: Campus France 'Accord préalable' or Etudes en France (EEF) certificate
Proof of enrollment in a French educational institution
Proof of financial resources (minimum €615 per month) via blocked account or guarantor
Proof of accommodation in France for at least the first 3 months

spain.name: Spain (Schengen)
spain.description: A top choice for summer holidays and family visits. Processed via BLS International.

tourist.name: Tourist / Family Visit (Type C)
tourist.description: Short stay visa for tourism or visiting family in Spain.
requirements: Visa application form completed in Spanish or French
Hotel reservation or Invitation letter (Carta de Invitación from Policia Nacional)
Copies of all previous Schengen visas

italy.name: Italy
italy.description: Famous for its rich history and business opportunities (Decreto Flussi).

belgium.name: Belgium
belgium.description: Heart of the EU, highly requested for family visits and university studies.

canada.name: Canada
canada.description: Whether you want to study, work, or visit, we help you navigate the complex IRCC portal.

visitor.name: Visitor Visa (TRV)
visitor.description: For tourism, visiting family, or short business trips to Canada.
requirements: Proof of funds (Bank statements, property ownership, sponsor letters)
Letter of explanation detailing the purpose of the trip
Ties to home country proof (employment letter, family ties, property)

study.name: Study Permit
study.description: Required for international students to study at Designated Learning Institutions (DLI) in Canada.
requirements: Letter of Acceptance from a Canadian DLI
Proof of financial support (tuition + $20,635 CAD for living expenses)
CAQ (Certificat d'acceptation du Québec) if studying in Quebec
Medical exam and Police certificate (if required)

usa.name: United States
usa.description: Expert assistance with the DS-160 form and rigorous mock interview preparation for the US Embassy.

b1b2.name: B1/B2 Tourist & Business
b1b2.description: Non-immigrant visa for persons traveling to the US temporarily for business (B-1) or for pleasure/medical treatment (B-2).
requirements: Valid Passport (valid for at least 6 months beyond period of stay)
DS-160 Nonimmigrant Visa Application Confirmation Page
US Visa Photo (2x2 inches, white background, no glasses)
Proof of strong ties to Morocco (employment, property, family)
Travel itinerary or letter of invitation (if applicable)

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.description: Seamless application processing via TLScontact for tourism, business, and study in the UK.

visitor.name: Standard Visitor Visa
visitor.description: For tourism, business, study (courses up to 6 months), and other permitted activities.
requirements: Financial evidence (Bank statements showing consistent income and savings)
Proof of employment (letter from employer stating salary, role, and approved leave)
Detailed travel itinerary and estimated costs

gulf.name: Gulf Countries (UAE, KSA, Qatar)
gulf.description: Fast-track processing for Dubai tourist e-visas, Saudi Umrah packages, and Qatar business visas.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: Welcome to VisaPlus. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our website.
privacy.dataCollectText: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
privacy.dataList1: Identity Data: includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier.
privacy.dataList2: Contact Data: includes billing address, email address and telephone numbers.
privacy.dataList3: Document Data: includes passport copies, financial statements, and other sensitive documents required for visa processing.
privacy.useDataText: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data to process your visa application and communicate with embassies on your behalf.
privacy.securityText: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@visaplus.com.

schengen.title: Schengen Visas
schengen.subtitle: Complete assistance for Tourist, Business, and Family Visit visas to France, Spain, Italy, Germany, and all 27 Schengen member states.
schengen.type: Type C — Short Stay (up to 90 days)
schengen.step1Desc: We analyze your profile and compile the exact checklist needed.
schengen.step2Desc: Translation of Arabic documents to French/English/Spanish, filling forms.
schengen.step3Desc: Securing a slot at VFS Global, TLScontact, or BLS.
schengen.step4Desc: You submit your file and biometrics at the application center.
schengen.step5Desc: Tracking your application until your passport is returned.
schengen.req1: Valid Passport (issued within last 10 years, valid for 3+ months beyond return date, 2+ blank pages)
schengen.req2: Two recent biometric passport photos (ICAO standard, white background)
schengen.req3: Schengen Visa application form, fully completed and signed
schengen.req4: Travel Medical Insurance (minimum coverage €30,000, valid for entire Schengen area)
schengen.req5: Proof of Accommodation (hotel reservation, host invitation 'Attestation d'accueil', or rental agreement)
schengen.req6: Round-trip flight reservation or travel itinerary
schengen.req7: Proof of Financial Means (bank statements for last 3 months showing min. 3000 MAD/day or sponsor letter)
schengen.req8: Proof of Socio-Economic Status (work certificate, last 3 salary slips, CNSS registration, or commerce registry for business owners)
schengen.req9: Family record book (Livret de famille) for married applicants
schengen.note: Note: Additional documents may be required depending on your specific socio-economic status (e.g., pensioners, students, minors).
schengen.validityDesc: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
